questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg har rejst lidt rundt i Italien tidligere, og så har jeg arbejdet i en italiensk restaurant længe, så jeg kendte en del til kulturen og lidt til sporget allerede.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var bestemt svært.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var ikke så meget hjælp at hente. Man måtte søge lidt frem på nettet, og ellers møde op fysisk til office hours.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Kend nogen:)

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det ved jeg ikke? Vel bare at der ikke er så mange studerende, og at man derved kan være heldig at bo lidt mere autentisk

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det er jo en lang, besværlig og bureaukratisk proces. Det er nokfor det bedste, men jeg mistede da godt nok næsten lysten til at tage afsted, fordi det var så svært at gennemskue.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Frustrerende, drænende, svært at få hjælp til. Man er meget efterladt på egen hånd.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Det ved jeg ikke, men når I finder den, vil jeg mega gerne høre om den:D

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg endte med at tage nogle andre fag, ed dem jeg havde fundet i første omgang, men det var helt fint.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Start i god tid, nok bare. Det er en ret hård og frustrerende proces (det var det i hvert fald for mig), så det er rart ikke at gøre dagen før deadline.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg tog kun kandidatfag, selvom jeg var på sidste semester af bacheloren. Det fungerede helt fint.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: På KU værdsætter mine undervisere meget den kritiske tænkning. Sådan var det virkelig ikke på Statale Milano. Fokus var mere på personer, årstal og begivenheder, så mit råd er at fokusere mere på det. Det er også meget mere tavle-undervisning og langt mindre interaktivt, end jeg var vant til fra KU.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Intellectuals, popular culture, collective identities: Italy and Europe in the 19th and 20th centuries,
Representations of value: money and capital from clay tablets to cryptocurrencies,
Global citizenship,
Critical thinking and argumentation

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Dem alle! Jeg syntes, jeg lærte en masse af dem alle sammen. Det handler nok bare om, hvad man synes er spændende

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ikke nogle

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Indkøb er relativt billigt. Det samme gælder for drinks, kaffe og at spise ude generelt. Man kan godt gøre det ret billigt og alligevel få kvalitets-mad. Mega skønt.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg ved det ikke. Jeg var ikke rigtig til det

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var vist filmklubber, museumsture, guidede ture rundt i byen, men jeg var ikke lige med

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Mange af byens museer er gratis den første søndag i hver måned. Det kan man sagtens bruge lidt tid på.
Ellers prøv at finde nogle billetter til konservatoriets koncerter. Jeg datede en studerende derfra og var af den grund til en koncert der. Det var helt vildt, det kan virkelig anbefales.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Milano er et godt udgangspunkt til at tage til andre byer. Jeg var selv i Venedig på Biennalen. Det var virkelig storslået. Det kan jeg godt anbefale.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Nemt nok, hvis man har lyst til at følge alle skikkene, men nogle gange vil man måske også bare gerne være sig selv og dansk at heart.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Min oplevelse er, at italienere generelt er meget åbne og spontane, så hvis man kan lægge sin danske frygt for at være til besvær/ uønsket, kan man sagtens møde søde, oprigtige mennesker bare ved at starte en samtale.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer:
Spisetiderne! Jeg syntes, det var hårdt at spise aftensmad med folk, der ikke var sultne før kl 21. Sådan er vi jo forskellige.
Forholdet til hjemløse - der er virkelig mange hjemløse mennesker i Milano, og det kan godt være lidt ubehageligt at blive konfronteret med.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Maden, åbenheden, generøsiteten, gæstfriheden, spontaniteten, kvalitetsbevidstheden, respekten for ældre mennesker

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Metroen stopper med at køre ved en 1/2 tiden om aftenen, så det kan være værd at planlægge sin aften enten tæt på hjem eller være indstillet på at tage taxa / uber.
Kritisk tænkning vægtes ikke så højt her, som det gør på KU.
At være universitetsstuderende i Milano optager langt mindre af ens tid, end det gør at være studerende i København. Jeg havde f.eks. næsten aldrig "lektier", hvilket var helt skørt for mig.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg ved ikke, om det også kommer til at være sådan fremadrettet, men da jeg skulle søge fag, kunne jeg ikke se humaniora fag. Jeg troede faktisk bare ikke, de eksisterede. Det viste sig så, at de blev uploadet 1,5 (!!!) uge før semesterstart, så jeg vidste ikke, de fandtes inden da.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det er virkelig givende at møde folk fra andre lande og fagligheder. Man bliver så meget mere bevidst om sin egen position i verden i mødet med andre.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Klart alt det administrative. Den er ikke for børn.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
